items.text: Noteway Camera is now set to Rocksmith 2014 Noteway Camera by default (Guitar/Bass Only)
Added the ability to favorite multiple tones, and change to them in the menu or during a song at a moments notice with the addition of the Pedal Board
The tone manager menu on the Customize screen is now available for Piano
Added direct linking functionality to existing onboarding challenges
Added multi-select filter functionality to Search Result including Artist Linking (selecting the artist name in the song details)
Added local filtering and sorting to My Saved Songs, Recently Played, Greatest Hits, and New This Month song queues in Expanded view
Updated the Search landing screen, providing theme, tuning, and artist based queues to improve song discovery
New dialogue reminding unsubscribed players about subscription perks
･ "Authentic Arrangement" filter is now set by default in Search
･ Added bookmarking functionality in Song Results
･ Fixed several issues
For those who experienced subscription issues in our launch week, or may have hesitated to be an early adopter...we're happy to say some our most common issues have been addressed.
All incidents of suspended accounts after cancelling payment have been resolved as of June 12. We see zero users with a suspended status.

For users who saw double billings using Steam Wallet, we worked with Valve and they have informed us the bug was fixed and refunds were issued the morning of June 12. You should already see a refund for the erroneous payment to your account (your banking situation may vary).
Thank you for all your patience as we expanded to Steam and worked together to resolve these issues as quickly as we could!
If you are still seeing either of the above issues, please create a support ticket or join the discussions.
Fixed an issue with anchor positions in certain songs.
